title: AI安全审计报告：FastAPI代码质量评估
author: lcclicheng
body_preview: ## 🕳️ AI 代码审计报告  对 FastAPI (tiangolo/fastapi) 进行了自动安全扫描。  ### 扫描概况  - 源文件: 1,120 个 Python 文件 (109,217 行代码) - 发现: 2 类安全模式  ### 发现详情  **1. 命令执行相关调用（3处）** - 存在 subprocess.Popen / os.system 等调用 - 建议: 审查这些调用是否涉及用户输入，使用 shlex.quote 处理参数  **2. 配置密钥（4处）** - 代码中包含 SECRET_KEY 等配置字面量 - 建议: 生产环境通过环境变量注入  ---  📊 FastAPI 整体代码质量较高。 本次扫描基于静态代码分析，未进行动态验证。  ⚡ 扫描工具: ONESEC v4.0（多语言引擎：Go + Python）  > 如需对您的项目做安全审计，可联系...

title: Multipart parser drops last byte when file content ends with \r (0x0D)
author: hanbo79
body_preview: Environment    - Python 3.10   - Werkzeug 3.1.4   - Flask 3.0.0   - OS: Linux    Summary    When uploading a file via multipart/form-data with FileStorage.save(), if the binary file content's last byte is 0x0D (\r), Werkzeug's multipart parser   incorrectly treats it as part of the boundary delimiter (\r\n--BOUNDARY), stripping it from the file. title: Relative priority of routing rules can change from unrelated rules
author: sdegueldre
body_preview: ## Titular issue  Have two rules with a dynamic segment using different converters with the same weight in your application. title: Migrate sentinels to use Python 3.15's PEP 661 `sentinel` built-in with typing_extensions backport
author: AndreasBackx
body_preview: Migrate sentinel values like at `src/click/_utils.py` to use the introduced `sentinel` built-in coming in Python 3.15. For older versions we can use [`typing_extenions.sentinel`](https://typing-extensions.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html#typing_extensions.sentinel).
